requirements.provenance: All imported numeric values must carry sourceId, referenceYear, unit, geographicCoverage, isEstimate and licenseCheck.
requirements.historicalUncertainty: Different estimates for pre-modern population and survival must remain labelled estimates; do not invent exact chance distributions.

requirements.ages: An average life expectancy is NOT an age-of-death roll; proper life table data and period-specific uncertainty are needed.
requirements.eventImpact: Documentary event year != exact personal casualty rate or universal event reach.
